name: pdf
description: PDF document production skills, published as an official ZCode plugin. Includes a read-only workspace viewer for shared reading, search, references and captures.

description_i18n.en: PDF production skills: typeset and render reports, resumes, posters, and covers to PDF. Read together in a read-only workspace panel with anchor references, search, highlights and captures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: PDF 制作技能：报告、简历、海报、封面的排版与渲染输出。 支持工作区只读共同阅读、锚点引用、搜索、高亮与截图。
